text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come for Mihono
Bourbon
and I to take on the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My first objective in the Twinkle Series is
to win
the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I wish to continue gradually
strengthening my
body in order to
achieve this goal.
We're here to win the Triple Crown and prove that one can supplement stamina through hard work.
choice_data_list: もちろん！一緒に頑張ろう！
choice_data_list_en: Of course! Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.text: Our training begins today!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant, pant!

Some figures standing off in the distance
are
watching Bourbon as she trains
vigorously.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's Bourbon. She's going at it
hard again
today.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? She runs six inclines every
day. That
kind of workload is almost
worrying...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: 頑張れ、あともう1往復だ！
頑張れ、あともう1往復だよ！
choice_data_list_en: Keep at it, just one more round trip!
Hang in there, just one more round trip!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work today,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am merely following the training
regimen you
provided.
choice_data_list: 今日もよく頑張ったな
今日もよく頑張ったね
choice_data_list_en: You worked really hard today, too.
You worked really hard today as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your efforts deserve more praise than
mine.

Mihono Bourbon's training regimen is
very strict
compared to that of other
runners.
choice_data_list_en: No, that's all your hard work.
No, it's all thanks to your hard work.

text_block_list.text:
I doubt there are many who can do what
she does
without complaint.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

Her usually unemotional expression
softens a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Right!
choice_data_list: トゥインクル・シリーズ、頑張ろうな！
トゥインクル・シリーズ、頑張ろうね！
choice_data_list_en: Let's give it our all in the Twinkle Series!
Let's do our best in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.text:
The arduous training is certainly helping
her
progress.

Just as I'm heading to my office to
further refine
Bourbon's training
regimen...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Do you have a moment?
I'm stopped by a fellow trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it's okay to put Mihono
Bourbon
through such brutal stamina
training?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: So you say, but...
choice_data_list: 彼女ならやり遂げられる

text_block_list.text:
He gives me a troubled look and
scratches his
head.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She is very obedient—some might say
oddly so.
I've heard rumors you're taking
advantage of
that.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Plus, she's a sprinter no matter how you
look at
her. Don't let her potential go to
waste.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Really?
choice_data_list: そんなつもりじゃない
choice_data_list_en: I didn't mean it that way.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Really.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Triple Crown is a dream I
originally
shared with my father. Now,
my trainer is chasing
that dream with me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's meticulous training has allowed
me to
reliably improve my
cardiopulmonary functions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In addition to training for consistent
completion
times of medium- and
long-distance races...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I recently recorded a time of one minute
and
thirty-five seconds in a 1,600-meter
run. This is a
competitive time for junior
year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I surmise that these are the results
brought about
by Trainer's belief in my
strength.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, I currently have no
problems with
my mental or physical
health.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In short, I am "okay."

Mihono Bourbon speaks this entire
monologue in
nearly a single breath,
leaving my trainer
colleague
dumbfounded.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, I didn't expect a lecture from
you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This was not a "lecture." I merely
communicated
the facts.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Right. Okay, I'm sorry. That was
insensitive of
me.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I was just a bit worried because it
seemed like you
were being forced to
run beyond your breaking
point.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But I can see you really trust your
trainer. Stay
safe at the Twinkle Series,
then. I'll be rooting for
you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
After saying his piece, the trainer leaves.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not understand the intention behind
your
expression of gratitude. I merely
corrected a
misunderstanding.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I am not well-versed in such things.
choice_data_list: 信じてくれていることが嬉しかった
choice_data_list_en: It made me happy to know they had faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I have determined that your

instructions are essential for running in

long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see... So that's what it is.
choice_data_list: それが信じてくれてるってことだ
それが信じてくれてるってことだよ
choice_data_list_en: That means they believe in you.
That means they believe in you.

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Mihono Bourbon and I
embark on
a long journey to chase after
our dream!
